commit.messageHeadline: e2e: fix stuck-init wait predicate jsonpath (missing .status prefix)
commit.messageBody:
The startedAt query hit a nonexistent path, so the readiness condition
never passed and the scenario timed out despite the pod being correctly
stuck (confirmed by the CI run's describe dump).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

CI (golangci-lint v2.12.2) reported 39 issues on this branch; running the
same linter locally surfaced a handful more that the CI log had capped.
All are fixed at the source — no file-level exclusions were added to
.golangci.yml, and only one targeted //nolint (with a reason) was needed.

misspell (24): British -> US spellings in comments and test-case strings
  across internal/engine, internal/inspect, internal/sinks and
  internal/watch (behaviour, cancelled, marshalled, recognised, serialise,
  colour, honouring, summarises, cancelling). All occurrences were in
  comments or subtest names; no identifiers needed renaming.

errcheck (5): unchecked fmt.Fprintln to report/error writers in
  internal/inspect/inspect.go and internal/cli/root.go are now `_, _ =`,
  matching how the codebase already treats best-effort output. The
  enclosing helpers return int exit codes, not errors, so there is no
  error-propagation pattern to follow.

contextcheck (3): shutdownServers, startServers/serveMux and
  Controller.closeSinks now take the caller's context. The shutdown
  timeout is derived from context.WithoutCancel(ctx) rather than ctx
  directly: Run's deferred shutdown runs precisely when ctx is already
  canceled, so wrapping ctx itself would abort the graceful drain instead
  of honoring shutdownTimeout. This keeps the existing bounded
  grace-period semantics exactly.

noctx (4): net.Listen -> (&net.ListenConfig{}).Listen(ctx, ...) in
  internal/watch/server.go; httptest.NewRequestWithContext and
  http.NewRequestWithContext + client.Do in the sinks and watch tests
  (response bodies are still closed, keeping bodyclose satisfied).

gosec (2): G304 in internal/cli/ai_flags.go is resolved by filepath.Clean
  on the --ai-redact-extra path — reading an operator-provided pattern
  file is the documented feature. G101 on internal/sinks/loki.go's
  lokiEnvBearerToken carries the only //nolint in this change: the
  constant is the *name* of an env var, not a credential.

revive (4): doc comments on the three exported const blocks in
  internal/engine/types.go (block comments, not per-constant), and an
  unused test-helper parameter renamed to _.

staticcheck QF1002 (1): internal/collect/node.go uses a tagged switch on
  cond.Type. Because .golangci.yml sets default-signifies-exhaustive:
  false, the tagged form newly required full enum coverage, so the two
  non-pressure NodeConditionType values get an explicit no-op case —
  behaviorally identical to the previous untagged switch.

unparam (1): eventsMatching's `reason` parameter always received
  "Unhealthy" at all four call sites; it is dropped and applied inside
  the function.

copyloopvar (1): removed a redundant `tc := tc` in loki_test.go.

No behavior changes. gofmt clean, go build, go vet and
go test -race -count=1 ./... all pass; golangci-lint run ./... reports
0 issues.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

title: Prepare the v0.1.0 release
body:
Cut the CHANGELOG's Unreleased section as 0.1.0 and replace the pre-release claims in the README and chart README, which asserted there was no release, no downloadable binary and no chart distribution - all false the moment the tag is pushed.

Publish the Helm chart as an OCI artifact to ghcr.io/ryckakas/charts in a new release job, chosen over a gh-pages chart repository so there is no index.yaml or Pages branch to keep consistent and so it reuses the ghcr credentials the release workflow already needs. The job is gated on goreleaser succeeding, and refuses to push a chart whose appVersion does not match the tag, since appVersion is the image tag the chart deploys by default.

Renumber the chart from 0.1.1 to 0.1.0 so the first published chart matches its appVersion; 0.1.1 only ever existed pre-publication.

Narrow the workflow's top-level permissions to contents:read and grant the write scopes per job instead.

commit.messageBody:
Cut the CHANGELOG's Unreleased section as 0.1.0 and replace the
pre-release claims in the README and chart README, which asserted there
was no release, no downloadable binary and no chart distribution - all
false the moment the tag is pushed.

Publish the Helm chart as an OCI artifact to ghcr.io/ryckakas/charts in
a new release job, chosen over a gh-pages chart repository so there is
no index.yaml or Pages branch to keep consistent and so it reuses the
ghcr credentials the release workflow already needs. The job is gated on
goreleaser succeeding, and refuses to push a chart whose appVersion does
not match the tag, since appVersion is the image tag the chart deploys
by default.

Renumber the chart from 0.1.1 to 0.1.0 so the first published chart
matches its appVersion; 0.1.1 only ever existed pre-publication.

Narrow the workflow's top-level permissions to contents:read and grant
the write scopes per job instead.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
